purpose: Teach: 本校/（財）/先ごろ/片っ端/遅ればせながら/討ち/新報/追いつめ

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、本校、つまり本校の教育方針の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, I see you wrote your paper on this school's educational philosophy.
lines.style: Warm, encouraging tone. Soft opening, like she's drawing him into discussion. Patient pacing, giving space for him to respond. Professional but genuinely interested.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、（財）法人、つまり（財）の財団形態の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on the organizational structure of foundations.
lines.style: Careful, clarifying voice. Slight hesitation on the technical term, as if wanting to be precise. Respectful toward the teacher. Measured pace, earnest but not defensive.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、先ごろ発表された統計の分析研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, and you analyzed some recently released statistical data in your paper, correct?
lines.style: Thoughtful, checking-in tone. Gentle lift at the end like a question. Steady pace. Observant—she's genuinely tracking his work, not just reading off notes.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、片っ端から資料を集める研究手法を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, my paper examined a research methodology of systematically gathering materials.
lines.style: Measured, precise delivery. Slight emphasis on the method itself. Quiet confidence in what he studied. Even pace, no rush. Slightly formal register.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、遅ればせながら発表された研究の重要性を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you also addressed the significance of research that was published somewhat belatedly, I believe?
lines.style: Conversational, slightly curious. Gentle phrasing—'I believe'—shows respect for his expertise. Warm but professional. Unhurried cadence, genuine follow-up.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、敵を討ち取る、つまり仇討ちの歴史研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on the historical study of vendetta—the practice of seeking revenge.
lines.style: Deliberate, explanatory tone. Clear on the definition, as if helping her understand the term. Earnest without apology. Steady, grounded delivery. Slight formality.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、新報、つまり新報の創刊号研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you examined the inaugural issue of the Shinpō newspaper in your paper, then?
lines.style: Warm, confirming tone. Light curiosity in the voice. Soft conversational rhythm. She's walking him through his own work with genuine interest, not testing him.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、犯人を追いつめ、つまり追い詰める捜査心理学を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, my paper examined the investigative psychology of cornering suspects during interrogation.
lines.style: Clear, grounded delivery. Final line carries quiet weight—this is serious subject matter. Earnest throughout. Even pace, no trailing-off. Slight formality befitting the topic's gravity.
